name: Rocket v2 — Layer-2 Helper
description: 1x2 Layer-2 rocket. Play the fuse Box behind it to fire. Hits a single target Box on the maze (magnet pick), revealing the two boxes under the rocket.
howToPlay: Each rocket has a dashed fuse-line pointing at its fuse Box (the cell directly behind its tail). Play the fuse Box to fire the rocket — it flies to a regular box on the maze and magnet-picks it (marbles fly straight to the sort columns). If no regular box is left, it targets another rocket's fuse instead — chain reaction! When a rocket fires, the two hidden boxes under it are revealed.
